about: Hand-made mappings for the ihp-sg13g2 gap table (GAPS-ihp-sg13g2 section 2). Keys are the IHP rule IDs, as both sides name them.

AFil.i.angle.note: Magic prints AFil.i for a rule that allows only 90-degree angles on Activ fill, which IHP's SG13G2 layout rules (Rev. 0.4) do not have; their AFil.i, which the maximal deck checks, is the 1.50 µm Activ:filler space to PWell:block (row AFil.i). KLayout checks Activ:filler for acute angles only

Padc.b.note: Magic prints this 40 µm pad spacing as Padc.e; in IHP's SG13G2 layout rules (Rev. 0.4) it is Padc.b, and their Padc.e is the CuPillarPad pitch, which neither tool checks

Seal.c1.note: Magic checks only the minimum width of the Via1-Via4 seal rings; the maximal deck also flags rings wider than 0.19 µm

Seal.d.note: Magic checks the Activ enclosure of the EdgeSeal-Cont ring only; the maximal deck checks it for the Cont, Via1-Via4, TopVia1 and TopVia2 rings

Seal.f.note: Magic's statement lists pdiff and m1-m6, not m7 (TopMetal2); the maximal deck checks EdgeSeal Activ, pSD, Metal1-Metal5, TopMetal1 and TopMetal2, and pSD is not in the layout rules' Seal.f list
